description: Godot node: read a node's type, script, non-default property values and connected signals. Pass properties to read only some.

path.description: Node path relative to the scene root ("." is the root), e.g. "Player/Sprite2D".

properties.description: Only these, e.g. ["position", "visible"]; ["*"] = all incl. defaults (default: non-default values only).

scene.description: Scene file, e.g. "res://main.tscn". Defaults to the scene open in the editor; required when the editor is closed.

name: godot_node_get
title: Get node
